text.p: Here are highlights from Polish newspapers this morning.
RZECZPOSPOLITA

- In the first 10 days of December food prices grew by 1.9 percent compared with the previous 10 days and by 2.2 percent compared with the same period last month, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.

- The following firms received the Gazeta Bankowa banking weekly's golden laurels for the best companies this year: Elbrewery breweries, ABB Dolmel engineering firm, Elektrobudowa construction firm, Fiat Auto Poland, TC Debica SA tyre company, Bartimpex foreign trade company, ZA Pulawy artificial fertiliser maker, Vistula garment producer and Zelmer household durable maker.

- The Warsaw-based Daewoo FSO car plant has received a clean production certificate for environment friendly changes. In the last three years the factory cut water consumption by 60 percent, Daewoo FSO's production director Maciej Motelski said.

- In the next six years the listed Swarzedz furniture maker will deliver furniture worth 200 million marks for Germany's International Moebelhandelskantor (IMK), controlled by the Schieder Group, under a recently signed contract.

- The Glinik mining machinery maker capital group's annual turnover will reach 200 million zlotys this year, while its net profit in the first 10 months of 1996 was 2.97 million zlotys, the management said.
NOWA EUROPA
- The price rates of motor liability premiums offered by the state-owned PZU insurance firm will be lower than recently announced, Poland's Finance Minister Grzegorz Kolodko said.
- Poland's current account deficit will reach $8 billion this year, the planning minstry's information and forecast department director Tadeusz Chroscicki said.
- France's Lafarge cement concern plans to invest 500 million zlotys in Poland in the next few years. The company now controls 22.5 percent of Poland's cement market, Lafarge said.
- Pioneer First Polish Trust Fund Co will postpone the launch of a money market fund planned for next year as the market is not yet sufficiently developed, Pioneer said.
GAZETA WYBORCZA
- The listed Budimex construction firm's net revenues in the first 10 months of 1996 were 245.5 million zlotys, which showed a 1.13 percent decline compared with the same period last year.
- Poland and Estonia will most likely sign a free trade agreement in March next year, Tallin-based Polish diplomat Andrzej Olborski said.
- The Warsaw-based Wedel confectionery maker's net profit in 1997 will be 50.5 million zlotys, the management's forecast said.
ZYCIE
- The 1995 sales revenues of the Kopex foreign trade company, to be privatised soon, reached $100 million, the treasury ministry said.
- The newly formed CERA SA rating agency will produce its first longterm securities' ratings in the first half of next year, CERA said.
PARKIET
- The listed Wedel confectioner plans to invest 75.6 million zlotys in development next year, the company said.
- The listed Farmfood food producer and trader plans to increase its share in Poland's meat market up to 15 percent by 2000, the company said.
- The listed Pekpol meat producer and trader plans to invest 30 million zlotys next year from its owned funds and preferential credits, the company said.
